renders.prompt: Explain the argument of this song as if to a bright 10-year-old. Short words. Concrete images. No jargon, no Sanskrit terms, no meta-commentary.

paragraphs.text: A pair of states, called doing-and-done; doing fades there, the doing-one does not fade again. Whatever bare trying faces a job gets lost here; lost, it cries I am totally lost — so the fool holds. But whoever faces inward, home of all-knowing: he never gets lost, seeing nothing else.

His seeing is always on, never failing in three states; the wide-awake one's forever — at start and end, but the other's. Whose shape is knowing and known, joined by top power: in two states the spreader shines, elsewhere made of knowing.
Stirrings that start with traits, leaning on shared stirring — may those who won themselves keep winning, with no one against the knower.
